name: travelguide-mobile
description: Android and iOS store packaging for 여쭈어

scripts.ios:simulator: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath build/ios-simulator CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:archive:unsigned: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath build/Yeojju.xcarchive CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO archive
